definitions.gloss: autumn leaves, fall colors, autumn foliage
definitions.explanation: The changing of leaf colors in autumn, particularly to red, orange, and yellow.
The activity of going to see autumn foliage.

examples.english: The mountain's autumn colors are at their peak.

examples.japanese: {紅葉|こうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It has become the season when autumn leaves are beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{紅葉|こうよう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{始|はじ}まり→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧、⟦{十一月|じゅういちがつ}→十一月：00635_juuichigatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{初|はじ}め→初め：02931_hajime⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{見頃|みごろ}→見頃：16868_migoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: This year the autumn colors started earlier than usual and reached their peak at the beginning of November.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧{紅葉|こうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}に→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to Kyoto to see the autumn leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{紅葉|こうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: We enjoyed the autumn leaves with the family on the weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紅葉|もみじ}{狩|が}り→紅葉狩り：05588_momijigari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シーズン→シーズン：10944_shiizun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なると→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧なお⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いっぱい→いっぱい：01793_ippai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When autumn leaf viewing season arrives, famous temples become packed with tourists.
examples.notes: ⟦{紅葉狩|もみじが}り→紅葉狩り：05588_momijigari⟧ is the traditional custom of visiting scenic spots to view autumn leaves.

notes:
READING NOTE: Can also be read as もみじ, which specifically refers to Japanese maple leaves or the tree itself.

CULTURAL NOTE: ⟦{紅葉狩|もみじが}り→紅葉狩り：05588_momijigari⟧ is the traditional Japanese custom of visiting scenic areas to view autumn leaves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{紅葉|こうよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧ (to enjoy autumn leaves)
・{紅葉|こうよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見頃|みごろ}→見頃：16868_migoro⟧ (autumn leaves are at their peak)
・⟦{紅葉|こうよう}{狩|が}り→紅葉狩り：05588_momijigari⟧ (autumn leaf viewing)
